INTERNAL MEMORANDUM.

From B.7. Mr. Aikin-Sneath.
To B.4 Mr. Robson-Scott.

I do not think you need bother to go through the attached files on GROEHL. It is true that he is working for a certain department. Any information which Miller may obtain about him is therefore particularly valuable. Has Miller any special reason for thinking that GROEHL is working for S.I.S.?

Date 14.7.41.
Signature [signature]
S. Form 161.
